previous_statement: By the registered theta-idempotent-approximation-map power-series estimate, applied to the delta-projection Q in the epsilon-Banach-C*-algebra, there are universal K_1<infinity and e_1>0 such that e<=e_1 implies ||tilde Q-Q||<=K_1*e, where tilde Q=Co_Q(Q)=u_Q by the registered column-hilbert-inner-product-displays.
new_statement: Let L=L_Q and R=R_Q on the underlying Banach space and set A=LR+RL-I in the associative Banach algebra B(A), so that Co_Q=theta(A) by the compression construction. There are universal K_1<infinity and e_1>0 such that e<=e_1 implies ||tilde Q-Q||=||(theta(A)-I)Q||<=K_1*e, where tilde Q=Co_Q(Q)=u_Q. Thus theta is used only in B(A), not in the generally nonassociative epsilon-Banach-C*-algebra.
